column8: ∀ (object : ℕ) (v0 v1 v2 v3 : ℤ), List.Pairwise (Minidregg.Compiler.StoreCodec.AddressLT Minidregg.Compiler.DeclaredEffectCell.wire) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.entries object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3))

∀ (object : ℕ) (v0 v1 v2 v3 w0 w1 w2 w3 : ℤ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.project object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3)) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four w0 w1 w2 w3)) = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.scalarSlots (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four w0 w1 w2 w3)

∀ (object : ℕ) (v0 v1 v2 v3 : ℤ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object 0 (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3)) = Option.some v0 ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object 1 (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3)) = Option.some v1 ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object 2 (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3)) = Option.some v2 ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object 3 (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.store object (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.four v0 v1 v2 v3)) = Option.some v3

∀ (object field : ℕ) (store pre : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store Minidregg.Theory.EffectDeclaration.effectLayout) (height : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object field (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Patch.run store (Minidregg.Compiler.DeclaredEffectCell.blinding.patch pre height)) = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.read object field store

∀ (object i j : ℕ), List.map UInt8.toNat (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.digestStream.encode { value := i }) < List.map UInt8.toNat (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.digestStream.encode { value := j }) → Minidregg.Compiler.StoreCodec.addressKey Minidregg.Compiler.DeclaredEffectCell.wire (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.key object i).address < Minidregg.Compiler.StoreCodec.addressKey Minidregg.Compiler.DeclaredEffectCell.wire (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.key object j).address

∀ (object field : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.StoreCodec.addressKey Minidregg.Compiler.DeclaredEffectCell.wire (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredFields.key object field).address = List.map UInt8.toNat (0 :: Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec.nat.encode object) ++ List.map UInt8.toNat (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.digestStream.encode { value := field })
